confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, beer, and cappuccino anchors reflect June 2026 citywide cost-of-living averages. Cocktail and wine prices vary by venue, so they are estimated relative to draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied year-typical comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mexico City’s capital and visitor demand support a three-star room price above Guadalajara’s $51, while keeping it below the more tourism-focused Puerto Vallarta and San Miguel de Allende at $82 and $80. A basic room near Guadalajara’s $40 benchmark and hostel prices near the supplied $12–18 dorm and $25–30 private-room range seem reasonable.
